## Orientation

Work only in ~/se-workflow on branch feat/dashboard-ui. `tests/test_e2e_dashboard.py` (side pane lifecycle) and `tests/test_tmux_integration.py` (popup and side pane bindings) were updated in 3e52964; check whether together they drive both the popup and the side pane through a lifecycle, and add only what is missing. The manual sign-off criterion belongs to the user; do not claim it. Capture real-terminal text frames of the real store (read-only) in a popup-sized and a 40%-side-pane-sized tmux client to /tmp/dashboard-shots/ for the user's review.
